name: teams-listener-demo
description: Small WebRTC meeting app (max 4 users) with live Azure Speech transcription.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
